_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

counties.basis: every Texas county the study covered

pollutants.basis: air pollutants the satellites measured, equal to the names listed

pollutant_names.basis: the eight pollutants in the order c4 lists them

data_year.basis: the year of the satellite readings

clusters.basis: major clusters of air pollution, east worst, west best, central between (c8)

algorithms.basis: machine learning algorithms the paper compared

r_squared.basis: the best model's R squared, support vector machine

r2_of_100.basis: r_squared x 100 rounded, drawn as filled cells of 100, a model fit

morans_i.basis: clustering of cancer prevalence between neighbouring counties

pub_day.basis: the day in March the paper went online
